# Börsen mot svag inledning – Asmodees vd om kvartalet

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The EFN Morgon episode was mostly about the AI sector after Jensen Huang said he is leaving as Nvidia's CEO. Nvidia's P/E multiple has fallen to 11.5. AMF's John Hernander still holds an overweight in Nvidia and sees memory makers SK Hynix and Samsung as cheap. He warned that the market depends heavily on AI-driven profit growth and that a slower data-center build-out is likely, given energy shortages and the US midterm results. Swedish coverage included a strong report from Asmodee (+10% at the open), weak October figures from Hemnet, a SEB buy call on Nibe, a Handelsbanken downgrade of Skistar, and an interview with VEF's CEO on exits, buybacks and Creditas.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

AMF (guest) stays overweight; P/E 11.5 despite expected ~70% growth; strong market position and software ecosystem.

#### Reasoning

Guest John Hernander (AMF) said buying Nvidia and holding it for one to two years will be a good investment. He pointed to very strong market positions, products and software. He expects volatility until a new CEO and management team are in place. The valuation looks like a no-growth company even though growth is expected next year, which implies a high risk premium.

#### Sell Triggers

- if next week's report fails to confirm full-year guidance
- if Q4 guidance is weak
- if CEO succession disrupts customer or supplier relations
- if data-center capex slows sharply

> *"att köpa en Nvidia och stoppa in det i byrålådan  och ta ut det om ett eller två år, kommer att vara en bra investering"*

---

### 🟢 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

AMF bought some SK Hynix; 2026-27 free cash flow equals half its market cap and the downturn is already priced in.

#### Reasoning

The guest said memory makers are priced for a severe downturn. Free cash flow after capex over 2026-27 equals about half the market cap. The industry is cyclical, but at this P/E and cash flow things must go very badly for the stock not to be worth buying. AMF moved money from Micron into SK Hynix.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the memory cycle turns sharply worse
- if a Chinese entrant takes significant share

> *"då ska det väldigt illa till, rent fundamentalt, för att det här inte ska vara köpvärt"*

---

### 🟠 005930.KS — Samsung | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The guest said it is cheap on free cash flow alongside SK Hynix, but AMF did not add to it.

#### Reasoning

Same valuation case as SK Hynix: the stock has been hit hard and already prices in the profit shift. There was no explicit purchase, so it is a watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the memory cycle deteriorates

> *"just SG Hynex och Samsung är aktier som har tagit väldigt mycket stryk och redan prisat in"*

---

### 🟡 MU — Micron | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

AMF reduced part of its Micron holding to fund SK Hynix.

#### Reasoning

This is a relative-value switch to the cheaper Korean peer, not an outright negative view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation gap to Korean peers widens further

> *"vi har minskat en del i amerikanska Micron"*

---

### 🟠 ASMDEE-B — Asmodee | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q2 beat with organic growth of 33.3%; card games surging and board games strong before the Christmas quarter, per guest Douglas Forsling (Cicero).

#### Reasoning

Guest Douglas Forsling (Cicero fonder) called the report very strong and above analyst estimates. Card games, driven by Pokémon's 30th anniversary, are well ahead of what analysts expected, and board games recovering is positive for the key Christmas quarter. The stock rose 10% at the open but gave back most of the gain to +3%. There was no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if card-game demand fades after the Pokémon anniversary peak
- if Christmas-quarter board game sales disappoint

> *"Den är väldigt stark. Den slår analytikernas förväntningar."*

---

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

SEB issued a buy recommendation (cited analyst view); stock up nearly 2%.

#### Reasoning

This is only a cited sell-side upgrade from SEB. The hosts gave no reasoning.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the heat pump demand recovery stalls

> *"Nibe som får en köprekommendation från SEB"*

---

### 🟡 SKIS-B — Skistar | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken cut it from buy to hold after a long buy stance; stock fell 4%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst downgrade. The hosts noted Handelsbanken had been a buyer for a long time, which explains the large share price reaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow
- if winter season bookings weaken

> *"Skistar får en sänkt rekommendation från Handelsbanken från köp till behåll"*

---

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

October net sales fell nearly 25% y/y to SEK 112m; stock down 1-2%.

#### Reasoning

Hemnet's preliminary October figures showed a sharp revenue drop, which the newsreader called a 'horror story' (skräcknyhet). The share price reaction was modest and no recommendation was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if monthly revenue declines continue

> *"Nettoomsättningen uppgick till 112 miljoner kronor jämfört med 148,7 året innan"*

---

### 🟠 VEFAB — VEF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

~56% NAV discount; the CEO expects more exits next year that would validate NAV and fund buybacks; Creditas is growing.

#### Reasoning

This is the company's own CEO speaking, so it is promotional. The catalysts are exits at or above NAV (the last one was at a premium), debt paydown and then buybacks. Its largest holding, Creditas, has accelerated growth for nine straight quarters. Uncertain exit timing and Brazilian politics are the risks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no exits happen in 2027
- if Creditas growth stalls
- if exits come below NAV
